beer.beer_description: Extra Hoppy Red Ale

Our Fresh New Hazy IPA uses a combination of Mosaic and Citra along with some out of this world hop heavyweights Strata and Galaxy. Sweet Passionfruit and Pineapple fight for centre stage against Herbal Resinous pine and Grapefruit pith. A clean Pilsner malt base is used alongside Oats to provide a smooth and creamy mouthfeel, but an addition of a not so common heirloom species of wheat 'Spelt Malt' creates a slightly tangy finish which accentuates a punchy hop bitterness.
Pretty as a picture and taking you out of this Stratosphere into another Galaxy.
Unfiltered IPA

Howdy Angel.
Try this beauty when the mood gets you down. A full noise NZ Hazy IPA, packed full of Nectaron and Nelson Sauvin hop to provide enough juicy tropical fruit flavour to keep your bottom lip from dragging on the ground
An intoxicating aroma of passionfruit, white wine, peach and mango with pungent sticky green herb.
It is as unapologetically kiwi as it gets.

Responsible on weekdays, because someone has to be. Experimenting with a new US hop blend Sitiva, and accompanied with Eldorado and Mosaic.
Restrained on the abv but still full of flavour, Soft peachy mouthfeel, fresh squeezed lime, mango and a touch of herb… Mid strength for the mid week to get you through hump day because fun and flavour doesn’t just have to be for the weekend!

A tart and refreshing mixed berry sorbet sour. Brewed with Blackberries, Boysenberries and Raspberries. 
Dare to Diva pours a stunning deep hazy magenta. Heavy jam-like and berry sorbet aromas greet you on the nose and the addition of Oats and Wheat provide enough body to balance out the sharp acidity.

In this world full of hazy beers we decided, just for fun, to brew a clear beer……WHAAAT!!!  US hop superstars Citra, Centennial and Simcoe bring the juicy citrus, tropical fruit punch, resinous pine and a touch of spice on the nose but with a whack of old skool IPA bitterness on the palate.

We finally managed to get our hands on the new American hop variety Talus!! 
Brewed alongside Mosaic and Azacca with a hefty addition of Oats to provide a smooth velvety mouthfeel.
Talus showcases strong aromas of Turkish delight and Rose petals which blend together seamlessly with Woody Vanilla and Coconut, Mosaic and Azacca provide Pineapple, Orange sherbet and fresh Citrus peel.
This next version of Equaliser combines both Citra and Mosaic hops. A delicate aroma of Citrus and Melon are gently balanced out with a soft bready malt base.

Celebrate World Pride with us, and dive into a world of flavour to support a cause close to the heart! Beer Baroness and Christchurch Pride join forces in an extraordinary collaboration that's brewed up something truly special. Introducing 'Queer Bear' - a limited edition Hazy IPA, crafted with care and passion, right here in Ōtautahi! We have dry hopped with Peacherine and late harvest Nelson Sauvin which combined give aromas of peach, nectarine, passionfruit, lime zest and to finish a hint of pink grapefruit.

The unmistakable flavour and aroma of Feijoas will either have you running for cover or fully immersing yourself in this delicate refreshing sour. Brewed with a large dose of wheat and oats to give a smooth creamy texture, a dash of salt, kettle soured, then conditioned with Feijoa to add a spritzy flavour overload and finished with corriander.

If you like Pina Colada’s and walking in the rain, then you may just like our special release Milkshake IPA.  Brewed with Pilsner, wheat and an addition of oats for added creaminess, followed by a hop bill featuring  Idaho 7, Mosaic, Sabro and HBC472 for the tropical coconut vibe.  We then turned it up a notch with the addition of Pineapple and Lactose sugar

We LOVE big fruit-loaded kettle sours! Filled to the brim with Sweet and Sour Cherries and treated with our usual dose of Oats and Wheat is a full-bodied juicy tart fruit bomb. Packed with Cherry flavour and just a hint of Marzipan.

If you don’t like Apricot then you won’t like this beer. Fresh apricot pie crust is the first thing that hits you face, followed by the puckering tartness, from 120kg of Apricots that went into our fermenter, that bring back childhood memories of Short Circuit sour lollies. Don’t worry there is still enough body and sweetness from the additions of Oats and Wheat to balance this fruity little number out.

Our Iconic Lady Danger, made even more dangerous!  Allow yourself to be seduced by the luxurious malt body, rich complexity and bright hoppiness hidden in this alluring red ale. We have taken a barrel of Lady Danger that has been ageing for over 12 months, and added this to our blend which has resulted in a potent perfume of ripe fruit wrestling in pine needles, enchanting the senses.  An abundance of US hops and balanced malt fullness round out the punchy flavours. This beer is perilously good and dangerously palatable, drinker beware.

Hazy IPA using Necaron Hops from local Canterbury Hop Farm - Okuora Farms
Once a year we get to brew a beer like this.  Freshly Harvested “wet” Nectaron Hops have been plunged into the cauldron to produce this potent medley of tropical fruit and Mandarin, with grassy resinous fresh hop goodness.

Our chosen Goddess, NYX, was Born From Chaos – literally! This is our take on a transcendental WCIPA, paying homage to the primordial Goddess of the Night. Her influence reigns over nightfall, sleep, dreams and even death… Many fear and respect her, including the mighty God, Zeus. This beer is punchy, crisp and refreshing – just like our girl NYX.

The Punchline.. the moment right before the laughter hits, this beer is here to fill the gap. Brewed from locally sourced malts, fermented with US05 & generously hopped with Idaho 7, Citra & Simcoe. Hop profile is grapefruit, passionfruit with hints of pineapple, peach & mango finishing with the spiny backbone of resinous pine. Full balanced mouthfeel accompanied by sample bitterness to compliment its thirst quenching finish

Layers of biscuit, toffee, caramalt, dark crystal and chocolate malty goodness meld together with dark candi syrup, dark crystal sugar and lactose to give a creamy, smooth silky mouthfeel, bitter dark caramel notes and a hint of salinity from a salt addition to the kettle. Cheesecake in a glass, double yum!!

It’s nearly summer! And to celebrate we have brewed a pineapple and lime fruit bomb.  Pineapple on mass up front, supported by a healthy zip of kaffir lime.  Wheat and oats give texture and mouthfeel, followed by traditional kettle souring to give a refreshing zing to finish.  Super yum and super quenching!

Sometimes the best ideas come at the last minute. Our robust Oatmeal coconut and vanilla stout has big bold roasty espresso notes wrapped in the oaky vanilla character that can only come from time relaxing in a bourbon barrel.

items.badge_description: It’s been a long day and now it’s time for a reward. Crisp, tasty and refreshing, enjoy that delicious fruit beer! That's 255 different fruited beers. Try 5 more for Level 52!

beer.beer_description:
For this years Stout Challenge entry we've brewed a milk stout that is layered with cacao and vanilla.

Ale, crystal, brown and chocolate malts form the malt base with lactose, cacao and vanilla added at the end of boil.

Luscious, smooth and moreish with a rich cacao and vanilla hit on the nose and in the mouth with just enough bitterness from the kettle additions of English Hop East Kent Goldings to balance out the sweetness.

Hoppy Hazy IPA Day! 

For the uninitiated, Sierra Nevada had the brilliant idea to create a day of celebration for hazies back in 2023! This year, we’re excited to introduce our third iteration of the Hazy IPA Day badge. 

Whether you call it hazy, murky, blurry, or New England style, let’s raise our glasses to these heavenly hoppy ales!
